definitions: If you are unable to overcome an opposing group or idea, it is more pragmatic to align yourself with them.
To adopt the practices or beliefs of a group that one has been opposing, especially when it becomes clear that opposition is futile.
examples: After years of trying to compete with the larger company, she decided if you can't beat them, join them and applied for a job there.
The small businesses realised if you can't beat them, join them and formed a cooperative to compete with the big chains.
He used to criticise their methods, but now he's doing the same thing; I guess if you can't beat them, join them.
lemma: if you can't beat them, join them
source: if you can't beat them, join them
